description: The single source of truth for the pipeline node `type:` values each layer admits. Read by the Worker compiler test (services/elitea-worker-rust src/agents/graph/node_admission_parity_tests.rs), the Main save-time admission test (services/elitea-main internal/domain/pipelinelimits) and the Web editor test (apps/elitea-web runtimeContract.constants.test.ts). A node type is added here and in every layer in the same change; there are no feature flags for admission.

pending_wave_2a.comment: KNOWN DRIFT, recorded so that any new drift fails. `parallel` and `map` are not composed yet: the Worker compiler parses them but refuses them when the graph is bound, Main's save check admits both, the Web editor lists `parallel` (the Add-node menu hides it behind FIXED_PARALLEL_AUTHORING_ENABLED) and omits `map`. This object MUST become empty (and move the two types into `admitted`) when Wave 2a composes Parallel and Map. Each layer's test asserts its admitted set equals `admitted` plus exactly its own entry below.
